calls.title: Tomasz / Christian
calls.summary: The meeting highlighted the progress of GrowthBook’s proof of concept, detailing the nearing completion of the mobile test console developed by Vixen, although technical challenges remain. The team expressed a need for automation in user assignments for experiments, prompting Christian to prepare workarounds. A decision on GrowthBook as the primary platform is aimed within one to two weeks, contingent on resolving current issues. Cloud hosting was confirmed to reduce operational overhead, with pricing discussions set to involve engineering leadership. The importance of consolidating experimentation tools for effective engineering practices was emphasized, while a follow-up meeting is planned to address outstanding technical questions and share knowledge through recordings.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, experimentation, mobile test console, feature flags, pricing negotiation, data integration
